newsitem.title: USA: Amalgamated sees no reason for stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Amalgamated sees no reason for stock rise.

text.p: Amalgamated Exploration Inc said it sees no reason for the recent increased activity in trading of its stock.
Amalgamated shares were up three to 9-1/2.
The company said its fundamentals remain unchanged.

It also said it learned that a recommendation was issued over the Internet. It said it reviewed that recommendation and concluded it contains no information that has not already been disclosed in press releases and filings with regulatory agencies.
